text:
Hannah Li: flagging an incident impacting search freshness for a small set of tenants after a schema migration touched the embedding pipeline. Some recently onboarded trials and a few renewal-window customers are seeing missing results or stale matches.

Carlos Mendes: How many tenants and severity? Any PII or data loss risk?

Hannah Li: 11 tenants affected; issue is quality/freshness (missing recent docs in semantic search), not deletion. No PII exposure. Root cause looks like a schema mismatch that prevented the latest embedding batch from being committed to the index store. Engineers are replaying the failed batches and enabling a temporary fallback query path to return lexical/sparse results while we rebuild. ETA full catch-up ~3-5 hours; partial relief in ~30-45m.

Avery Brooks: From CS ops we should send: (1) a short incident alert to all affected tenants, (2) high-touch outreach to the 3 renewal-risk customers offering an immediate remediation call and a goodwill gesture, (3) an AE one-pager with suggested call script and quick credit language.

Sanjay Rao: Recommend we also offer a temporary feature flag to opt-in to the lexical fallback automatically for affected tenants, and provide assisted replay for any critical ingest windows at no charge.

Jules Martin (Legal): For initial outreach avoid specific credit amounts. Use: "We will assess eligibility for goodwill or service credits consistent with your agreement; your account team will follow up to confirm any offer." Also avoid wording that guarantees permanent retention changes in the first message.

Hannah Li: Draft short customer message below 1 keep concise and operational. Please review.

```
Hi [Customer name],

Were writing to let you know we detected a problem during a recent embedding commit that has temporarily impacted semantic search freshness for some accounts. Our engineers identified a schema mismatch in the embedding pipeline that prevented the latest batch from being committed. We are replaying the failed batches and enabling a temporary lexical fallback to reduce user impact.

What were doing:
- Replaying the failed embedding batches to restore semantic matches.
- Enabling a temporary lexical/sparse search fallback so queries return broader results while rebuild completes.
- Offering assisted replay for critical ingestion windows and prioritized monitoring for accounts with upcoming renewals.

Estimated timeline: partial mitigation in ~30-45 minutes; full catch-up expected within ~3-5 hours. You can follow the incident at <status.redwood.ai/inc/INC-2026-3333>.

Next steps: your CS lead will reach out with an update and to schedule any remediation or assisted replay. We will also evaluate eligibility for credits consistent with your agreement and confirm any offer in follow-up.

We apologize for the disruption and appreciate your patience.

D Hannah, Customer Success
```

Carlos Mendes: LGTM. For the renewal cohort add: "If youd like a dedicated technical walkthrough and post-recovery monitoring, tell us preferred times and well schedule within 24 hours."

Avery Brooks: Ill build the AE one-pager with impacted tenants, suggested scripts (including the legal line), sample query diffs, and a checklist for assisted replays. Also adding a short feedback form link to capture sample failed queries so eng can triage faster.

status-bot: Incident INC-2026-3333 created (severity: medium). Postmortem scheduled tomorrow 10:30 AM PT.

Sanjay Rao: Ill own the renewal outreach and coordinate replay windows with eng. Can Avery share the sample query list and the feedback form link?

Avery Brooks: Yes D sharing now and adding a CS tracker row to capture outcomes (accepted replay, declined, asked for credits, risk flag update).

Hannah Li: Thanks team. Sending the general note after Jules confirms the legal line. Will prioritize the 3 renewal accounts for one-on-one outreach. :white_check_mark:
